statements.text: AI is best understood as a new kind of mind, more than a tool or artifact.
Advanced AI poses a real risk of human extinction.
How technology reshapes work and society is decided by collective choice rather than an inevitable process.
Technology-driven productivity growth leaves most workers better off without any change in public policy.
Individual freedom and democracy are compatible.
Public promises about advanced AI are mostly inflated hype.
Liberal and humane ideals have enough inherent force to prevail in long contests between societies.
Market competition limits the harm that economic actors can do.
Human beings should remain the end that AI serves, and should not be treated as a stage to surpass.
Public discussion of AI is inflated by hype that outruns what the technology has shown.
The AI dangers most worth attention come from present human deployment of AI, not from autonomous superintelligent agents.
AI systems may come to merit rights or moral consideration.
The history of earlier general-purpose technologies is a valid guide to how AI will behave and be received.
On hard questions, deferring to base rates or the average of informed opinion is a sound default over one's own reasoning.
Popular self-government should remain the basis of political authority, rather than rule by experts, executives or other unelected powers.
Market-driven technological development serves human beings on balance.
Governments should impose binding rules on frontier AI developers.
Stringent AI regulation now would do more harm than good by deterring innovation.
AI development should remain separate from state direction and control.
Technology should aim at cooperation across diverse groups rather than convergence on a singularity.
Rivalry with China is a sound reason for the United States to press ahead in advanced technology and protect its lead.
Distributing wealth or ownership directly to citizens is a sound way to share technology's gains.
Development of the most powerful general AI systems should be deliberately slowed or stopped.
AI systems can and should be given values that lead to good outcomes.
